pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Free: $0/month with 50 message credits; Hobby: $32/month (annual billing) or $40/month (monthly)…; Standard: $120/month (annual billing) or $150/month (monthly) with 4,000 message credits; Pro: $400/month (annual billing) or $500/month (monthly) with 15,000 message credits"

api_available.evidence: Web search summary: "The Standard plan adds Helpdesk, voice, telephony, and API access."

nl.tagline: Eigen AI-chatbot trainen op je website en documenten
nl.description: Met Chatbase train je een AI-agent op je eigen website, documenten en helpcenter en plaats je die als chatwidget of koppel je hem aan kanalen als WhatsApp en Slack. Je betaalt per AI-antwoord (message credits).
bestFor: Snel een chatbot op eigen content
limitations: Verbruik per bericht; extra credits bijkopen kost circa $40 per 1.000

en.tagline: Train your own AI chatbot on your website and documents
en.description: Chatbase lets you train an AI agent on your website, documents and help center and deploy it as a chat widget or on channels such as WhatsApp and Slack. You pay per AI reply (message credits).
bestFor: A chatbot on your own content, fast
notFor: Large support teams with complex tickets
limitations: Per-message usage; extra credits cost about $40 per 1,000
